data.one_liner: Customizable multi-select and checklist widgets for Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides MultiSelectContainer and MultiSelectCard widgets to easily render selectable chip-style lists or grid items. Supports single-item selection, custom decorations, prefixes/suffixes, limit constraints, and controllers.
use_when: You need tag selection or multiple-choice filtering interfaces.
You want highly customizable item decorations and prefix/suffix icons for selected/unselected states.
You need to limit the maximum number of selectable items.
avoid_when: You are building standard single-choice dropdowns or native select menus.
You require complex form field integration with FormField validation built directly into Flutter's Form system without custom controllers.
strengths: Highly customizable decorations and text styles for both groups and individual items.
Supports prefixes, suffixes, and custom widgets per item or globally.
Includes a controller to programmatically manage selections.
weaknesses: Limited documentation beyond basic examples in the README.
Does not appear to have official FormField integration out-of-the-box.
